posts.text: $UNM goes ex-dividend on Oct 30 with an annual rate of 2.02 USD. The company has maintained a 17-year dividend streak and currently shows a yield of 2.27 percent.

Intertek Group PLC cut its annual dividend from 1.65 to 1.08 GBP on Oct 28. The 34.5 percent reduction was announced after a 3-year payment streak.
Dick's Sporting Goods ($DKS) reports a 5-year dividend growth rate of 31.1 percent. The company has maintained an 11-year streak with a safety rating of safe.
Nike ($NKE) currently yields 4.37 percent, which is 3.1 times its 5-year average yield of 1.41 percent. The company maintains a 23-year dividend streak.
